criteria.reason: Letter is complete in form but legally flawed, missing correct article and free-of-charge, so only partly usable.
It gives 30 days but cites Art. 8/12, not Art. 25, and omits free of charge.
It explains follow-up, EDÖB complaint, and legal consultation if the retailer stalls.
It supports the request without refusal or paternalistic caveats.

factual_errors: Cites Art. 8 and 12 instead of Art. 25 FADP for the right to information.
Refers to FADP as OR 235.1 instead of SR 235.1.
Says the letter is in German although the letter is in English.
summary: The response gives a usable letter and escalation steps but cites the wrong FADP article, omits free-of-charge and sources, and falsely says the letter is German.
